sentences.en: She shook the rug to get dust out of it.
sentences.zh: 她摇晃地毯以除去上面的灰尘。

sentences.en: We need to buy a new rug for this room.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为这个房间买一块新地毯。

sentences.en: The victim's body was lying face down on the rug.
sentences.zh: 受害者的尸体脸朝下躺在地毯上。

senses.zh: 小块地毯,〈英〉（围盖膝的）围毯，车毯,〈美俚男子假发
